meta.title: Reliance
meta.description: One ought to fight with all their might as long as there's a chance to turn the tables.

units.rawText: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, roughly 500 meters from an Entropic horde.
units.displayText: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, roughly 500 meters from an Entropic horde.

spans.text: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector, roughly 500 meters from an Entropic horde.

units.rawText: This is the last damaged communications node. We'll be able to talk to Hannah once it's fixed.
units.displayText: This is the last damaged communications node. We'll be able to talk to Hannah once it's fixed.

spans.text: This is the last damaged communications node. We'll be able to talk to Hannah once it's fixed.

units.rawText: It'll be done soon, at least!
units.displayText: It'll be done soon, at least!

spans.text: It'll be done soon, at least!

units.rawText: You make it sound so easy. Who's the one doing all the actual work here?
units.displayText: You make it sound so easy. Who's the one doing all the actual work here?

spans.text: You make it sound so easy. Who's the one doing all the actual work here?

units.rawText: Yes, yes, it's all thanks to the great Lady Antonina.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, it's all thanks to the great Lady Antonina.

spans.text: Yes, yes, it's all thanks to the great Lady Antonina.

units.rawText: I'll pilot Dirac to high ground and keep a lookout.
units.displayText: I'll pilot Dirac to high ground and keep a lookout.

spans.text: I'll pilot Dirac to high ground and keep a lookout.

units.rawText: I'll go patrol the surrounding area too.
units.displayText: I'll go patrol the surrounding area too.

spans.text: I'll go patrol the surrounding area too.

units.rawText: Thank you all.
units.displayText: Thank you all.

spans.text: Thank you all.

units.rawText: Croque leaves in her giant mecha while Sol begins walking her route with swords in hand. Once Antonina finishes repairing the circuit, I quickly send out a transmission.
units.displayText: Croque leaves in her giant mecha while Sol begins walking her route with swords in hand. Once Antonina finishes repairing the circuit, I quickly send out a transmission.

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: Hello, this is <cmdr>, do you read me?
units.displayText: Hello, this is {교수}, do you read me?

spans.text: Hello, this is
, do you read me?

units.rawText: Yes, reading you loud and clear. I'm glad to hear from you again.
units.displayText: Yes, reading you loud and clear. I'm glad to hear from you again.

spans.text: Yes, reading you loud and clear. I'm glad to hear from you again.

units.rawText: It's been a while, Hannah. Are things alright on your end?
units.displayText: It's been a while, Hannah. Are things alright on your end?

spans.text: It's been a while, Hannah. Are things alright on your end?

units.rawText: Anna! Whew, I'm glad you're okay...
units.displayText: Anna! Whew, I'm glad you're okay...

spans.text: Anna! Whew, I'm glad you're okay...

units.rawText: Her familiar face looks exceptionally concerned.
units.displayText: Her familiar face looks exceptionally concerned.

spans.text: Her familiar face looks exceptionally concerned.

units.rawText: Hannah acts much more mature compared to our previous encounter in the Rossum Sector. But upon seeing Antonina, the look of delight on her face reminds me that she is but a child.
units.displayText: Hannah acts much more mature compared to our previous encounter in the Rossum Sector. But upon seeing Antonina, the look of delight on her face reminds me that she is but a child.

spans.text: Hannah acts much more mature compared to our previous encounter in the Rossum Sector. But upon seeing Antonina, the look of delight on her face reminds me that she is but a child.

units.rawText: Looks like you're on the outskirts of Rossum. I'm grateful for your trust in me even at such a dangerous time.
units.displayText: Looks like you're on the outskirts of Rossum. I'm grateful for your trust in me even at such a dangerous time.

spans.text: Looks like you're on the outskirts of Rossum. I'm grateful for your trust in me even at such a dangerous time.

units.rawText: Your rescue efforts could not have come at a more timely occasion.
units.displayText: Your rescue efforts could not have come at a more timely occasion.

spans.text: Your rescue efforts could not have come at a more timely occasion.

units.rawText: How are things on your side? Are you still safe?
units.displayText: How are things on your side? Are you still safe?

spans.text: How are things on your side? Are you still safe?

units.rawText: They're looking very bad. Only 35% of the Rossum Sector has yet to fall.
units.displayText: They're looking very bad. Only 35% of the Rossum Sector has yet to fall.

spans.text: They're looking very bad. Only 35% of the Rossum Sector has yet to fall.

units.rawText: Isn't that a bit too quick?
units.displayText: Isn't that a bit too quick?

spans.text: Isn't that a bit too quick?

units.rawText: The central avenues have been captured and we can't take them back.
units.displayText: The central avenues have been captured and we can't take them back.

spans.text: The central avenues have been captured and we can't take them back.

units.rawText: Those viruses that you call Entropics have been pouring out of the sector like an endless tide and then advancing in your direction...
units.displayText: Those viruses that you call Entropics have been pouring out of the sector like an endless tide and then advancing in your direction...

spans.text: Those viruses that you call Entropics have been pouring out of the sector like an endless tide and then advancing in your direction...

units.rawText: Don't worry, the Oasis is still holding out for now. How much longer can you remain safe?
units.displayText: Don't worry, the Oasis is still holding out for now. How much longer can you remain safe?

spans.text: Don't worry, the Oasis is still holding out for now. How much longer can you remain safe?

units.rawText: The remaining agents and I are hiding in the Administration Center, and given the barriers around us, we can last for another 44 minutes.
units.displayText: The remaining agents and I are hiding in the Administration Center, and given the barriers around us, we can last for another 44 minutes.

spans.text: The remaining agents and I are hiding in the Administration Center, and given the barriers around us, we can last for another 44 minutes.

units.rawText: Yeah, you need to do your best and hang in there. We're less than one klick from Rossum.
units.displayText: Yeah, you need to do your best and hang in there. We're less than one klick from Rossum.

spans.text: Yeah, you need to do your best and hang in there. We're less than one klick from Rossum.

units.rawText: That's good to hear. I'm sure the agents who can still fight will be glad to hear that.
units.displayText: That's good to hear. I'm sure the agents who can still fight will be glad to hear that.

spans.text: That's good to hear. I'm sure the agents who can still fight will be glad to hear that.

units.rawText: ...But before that, I need to confirm your solution with you.
units.displayText: ...But before that, I need to confirm your solution with you.

spans.text: ...But before that, I need to confirm your solution with you.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Hannah pauses for a moment, but then she immediately reacts.
units.displayText: Hannah pauses for a moment, but then she immediately reacts.

spans.text: Hannah pauses for a moment, but then she immediately reacts.

units.rawText: Do you mean the "High-Density Operand Railgun"?
units.displayText: Do you mean the "High-Density Operand Railgun"?

spans.text: Do you mean the "
High-Density Operand Railgun

units.rawText: So that really was it, huh?
units.displayText: So that really was it, huh?

spans.text: So that really was it, huh?

units.rawText: The High-Density Operand Railgun is Rossum's secret weapon, and also one of the reasons why I was willing to bring people along to help out.
units.displayText: The High-Density Operand Railgun is Rossum's secret weapon, and also one of the reasons why I was willing to bring people along to help out.

spans.text: The
High-Density Operand Railgun
is Rossum's secret weapon, and also one of the reasons why I was willing to bring people along to help out.

units.rawText: I confirmed it with Cyclopes' administrator. She said that she had weapon development logs for joint development of a "Self-Defense Armed Military Installation", but it wasn't complete when she sent it over to Rossum.
units.displayText: I confirmed it with Cyclopes' administrator. She said that she had weapon development logs for joint development of a "Self-Defense Armed Military Installation", but it wasn't complete when she sent it over to Rossum.

spans.text: I confirmed it with Cyclopes' administrator. She said that she had weapon development logs for joint development of a "Self-Defense Armed Military Installation", but it wasn't complete when she sent it over to Rossum.

units.rawText: I only just completed the technology for it recently.
units.displayText: I only just completed the technology for it recently.

spans.text: I only just completed the technology for it recently.

units.rawText: Everything in the cloud server is composed of operands, so compressing operand density would theoretically allow for tremendous destructive power in a small cannon chamber, and when combined with the Cyclopes Sector's stabilizing materials...
units.displayText: Everything in the cloud server is composed of operands, so compressing operand density would theoretically allow for tremendous destructive power in a small cannon chamber, and when combined with the Cyclopes Sector's stabilizing materials...

spans.text: Everything in the cloud server is composed of operands, so compressing operand density would theoretically allow for tremendous destructive power in a small cannon chamber, and when combined with the Cyclopes Sector's stabilizing materials...

units.rawText: I don't doubt that it'll work, Hannah. You don't have to go into all that detail about it.
units.displayText: I don't doubt that it'll work, Hannah. You don't have to go into all that detail about it.

spans.text: I don't doubt that it'll work, Hannah. You don't have to go into all that detail about it.

units.rawText: Ah... I'm sorry.
units.displayText: Ah... I'm sorry.

spans.text: Ah... I'm sorry.

units.rawText: Hannah suddenly cuts herself off, but she still looks very worried.
units.displayText: Hannah suddenly cuts herself off, but she still looks very worried.

spans.text: Hannah suddenly cuts herself off, but she still looks very worried.

units.rawText: I take it that since you're here, you must have brought the operands over?
units.displayText: I take it that since you're here, you must have brought the operands over?

spans.text: I take it that since you're here, you must have brought the operands over?

units.rawText: When it comes to sending packages, we live to deliver.
units.displayText: When it comes to sending packages, we live to deliver.

spans.text: When it comes to sending packages, we live to deliver.

units.rawText: Thank goodness. If you can bring us the operands, it'll only be a matter of time before we can take back the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: Thank goodness. If you can bring us the operands, it'll only be a matter of time before we can take back the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: Thank goodness. If you can bring us the operands, it'll only be a matter of time before we can take back the Rossum Sector.

units.rawText: I'll use the railgun to reduce them back to their basic operand particles.
units.displayText: I'll use the railgun to reduce them back to their basic operand particles.

spans.text: I'll use the railgun to reduce them back to their basic operand particles.

units.rawText: I would have done it already if it wasn't because I couldn't transfer our operand stockpiles over... At least, we wouldn't be cooped up here like this.
units.displayText: I would have done it already if it wasn't because I couldn't transfer our operand stockpiles over... At least, we wouldn't be cooped up here like this.

spans.text: I would have done it already if it wasn't because I couldn't transfer our operand stockpiles over... At least, we wouldn't be cooped up here like this.

units.rawText: Thing is, we've run into a small problem—Do you see the Entropics surrounding the Rossum Sector?
units.displayText: Thing is, we've run into a small problem—Do you see the Entropics surrounding the Rossum Sector?

spans.text: Thing is, we've run into a small problem—Do you see the Entropics surrounding the Rossum Sector?

units.rawText: There's just too many of them; we can't break through.
units.displayText: There's just too many of them; we can't break through.

spans.text: There's just too many of them; we can't break through.

units.rawText: Something's wrong with their numbers... Your reaction is understandable.
units.displayText: Something's wrong with their numbers... Your reaction is understandable.

spans.text: Something's wrong with their numbers... Your reaction is understandable.

units.rawText: So do you want to activate this cannon now?
units.displayText: So do you want to activate this cannon now?

spans.text: So do you want to activate this cannon now?

units.rawText: What is your operand supply like after subtracting the amount needed to sustain the Admin Center's barriers?
units.displayText: What is your operand supply like after subtracting the amount needed to sustain the Admin Center's barriers?

spans.text: What is your operand supply like after subtracting the amount needed to sustain the Admin Center's barriers?

units.rawText: I know what you're getting at. You don't need to be so concerned about us at times like this.
units.displayText: I know what you're getting at. You don't need to be so concerned about us at times like this.

spans.text: I know what you're getting at. You don't need to be so concerned about us at times like this.

units.rawText: After all, you're the ones taking risks to help us. If you run into danger while transporting the operands, we ought to use those operands to give you cover fire so you can successfully enter Rossum.
units.displayText: After all, you're the ones taking risks to help us. If you run into danger while transporting the operands, we ought to use those operands to give you cover fire so you can successfully enter Rossum.

spans.text: After all, you're the ones taking risks to help us. If you run into danger while transporting the operands, we ought to use those operands to give you cover fire so you can successfully enter Rossum.

units.rawText: Currently, we can reallocate enough operands to charge the High-Density Operand Railgun to 10%, but after that, we'll be completely spent.
units.displayText: Currently, we can reallocate enough operands to charge the High-Density Operand Railgun to 10%, but after that, we'll be completely spent.

spans.text: Currently, we can reallocate enough operands to charge the High-Density Operand Railgun to 10%, but after that, we'll be completely spent.

units.rawText: That sounds really pressing.
units.displayText: That sounds really pressing.

spans.text: That sounds really pressing.

units.rawText: Yes. We can only fire it once. After that, the team you're leading will be the Rossum Sector's only hope.
units.displayText: Yes. We can only fire it once. After that, the team you're leading will be the Rossum Sector's only hope.

spans.text: Yes. We can only fire it once. After that, the team you're leading will be the Rossum Sector's only hope.

units.rawText: Are you sure this is the best time?
units.displayText: Are you sure this is the best time?

spans.text: Are you sure this is the best time?

units.rawText: We don't have any other choice.
units.displayText: We don't have any other choice.

spans.text: We don't have any other choice.

units.rawText: Prof!
units.displayText: Prof!

spans.text: Prof!

units.rawText: Sol suddenly interrupts the exchange between Hannah and myself.
units.displayText: Sol suddenly interrupts the exchange between Hannah and myself.

spans.text: Sol suddenly interrupts the exchange between Hannah and myself.

units.rawText: Are you done yet? Those Entropics suddenly gathered up and they're heading right for us!
units.displayText: Are you done yet? Those Entropics suddenly gathered up and they're heading right for us!

spans.text: Are you done yet? Those Entropics suddenly gathered up and they're heading right for us!

units.rawText: Tsk... So they really did it after all...
units.displayText: Tsk... So they really did it after all...

spans.text: Tsk... So they really did it after all...

units.rawText: Even though we were outside their detection radius and they shouldn't have been able to spot us...
units.displayText: Even though we were outside their detection radius and they shouldn't have been able to spot us...

spans.text: Even though we were outside their detection radius and they shouldn't have been able to spot us...

units.rawText: I don't know what's going on either, but this is an emergency!
units.displayText: I don't know what's going on either, but this is an emergency!

spans.text: I don't know what's going on either, but this is an emergency!

units.rawText: Everyone, get ready for battle!
units.displayText: Everyone, get ready for battle!

spans.text: Everyone, get ready for battle!

units.rawText: The purple tide suddenly churns, and wave after wave of Entropics begin rushing toward our location.
units.displayText: The purple tide suddenly churns, and wave after wave of Entropics begin rushing toward our location.

spans.text: The purple tide suddenly churns, and wave after wave of Entropics begin rushing toward our location.

units.rawText: Croque! Don't rush too far ahead!
units.displayText: Croque! Don't rush too far ahead!

spans.text: Croque! Don't rush too far ahead!

units.rawText: Relax, Professor! You know what I want to do!
units.displayText: Relax, Professor! You know what I want to do!

spans.text: Relax, Professor! You know what I want to do!

units.rawText: Sol, buy Croque some time.
units.displayText: Sol, buy Croque some time.

spans.text: Sol, buy Croque some time.

units.rawText: Got it! Teams One and Two, cover us! Recon Team, with me!
units.displayText: Got it! Teams One and Two, cover us! Recon Team, with me!

spans.text: Got it! Teams One and Two, cover us! Recon Team, with me!

units.rawText: Good thing I've got anti-Entropy antibodies... Otherwise I'd also...
units.displayText: Good thing I've got anti-Entropy antibodies... Otherwise I'd also...

spans.text: Good thing I've got anti-Entropy antibodies... Otherwise I'd also...

units.rawText: Inside Dirac, Croque is slowly driven back as she takes the Entropic attacks. Sol is cutting enemies down left and right while Antonina is covering everyone from the rear.
units.displayText: Inside Dirac, Croque is slowly driven back as she takes the Entropic attacks. Sol is cutting enemies down left and right while Antonina is covering everyone from the rear.

spans.text: Inside Dirac, Croque is slowly driven back as she takes the Entropic attacks. Sol is cutting enemies down left and right while Antonina is covering everyone from the rear.

units.rawText: Croque! You okay?!
units.displayText: Croque! You okay?!

spans.text: Croque! You okay?!

units.rawText: I'm almost... ready... and done!
units.displayText: I'm almost... ready... and done!

spans.text: I'm almost... ready... and done!

units.rawText: Fall back in pairs! Move directly back! Do not let yourself get trapped in bad terrain. You'll be finished if you let them surround you!
units.displayText: Fall back in pairs! Move directly back! Do not let yourself get trapped in bad terrain. You'll be finished if you let them surround you!

spans.text: Fall back in pairs! Move directly back! Do not let yourself get trapped in bad terrain. You'll be finished if you let them surround you!

units.rawText: The agents begin retreating in response to Sol's shouts, giving Dirac some space.
units.displayText: The agents begin retreating in response to Sol's shouts, giving Dirac some space.

spans.text: The agents begin retreating in response to Sol's shouts, giving Dirac some space.

units.rawText: <size=40>PULSE—BOMBARDMENT!</size>
units.displayText: PULSE—BOMBARDMENT!

spans.text: PULSE—BOMBARDMENT!

units.rawText: The surrounding Entropic creatures are scattered like clouds of smoke, but the endless tide of Entropics continues pouring in from behind and they fill the breach in an instant.
units.displayText: The surrounding Entropic creatures are scattered like clouds of smoke, but the endless tide of Entropics continues pouring in from behind and they fill the breach in an instant.

spans.text: The surrounding Entropic creatures are scattered like clouds of smoke, but the endless tide of Entropics continues pouring in from behind and they fill the breach in an instant.

units.rawText: Despite the speed of the Entropics, it gives us a moment to breathe and lead the group towards Rossum.
units.displayText: Despite the speed of the Entropics, it gives us a moment to breathe and lead the group towards Rossum.

spans.text: Despite the speed of the Entropics, it gives us a moment to breathe and lead the group towards Rossum.

units.rawText: The Entropics dog our heels no matter which direction we retreat in. This is different from their aimless wandering from before. Now I can feel countless purplish-black eyes staring purposefully at me, constantly drawing closer to "me".
units.displayText: The Entropics dog our heels no matter which direction we retreat in. This is different from their aimless wandering from before. Now I can feel countless purplish-black eyes staring purposefully at me, constantly drawing closer to "me".

spans.text: The Entropics dog our heels no matter which direction we retreat in. This is different from their aimless wandering from before. Now I can feel countless purplish-black eyes staring purposefully at me, constantly drawing closer to "me".

units.rawText: This is bad, there're too many of them and we've got too many wounded...!
units.displayText: This is bad, there're too many of them and we've got too many wounded...!

spans.text: This is bad, there're too many of them and we've got too many wounded...!

units.rawText: This is just weird! They were nothing like this when Croque and I were scouting them earlier!
units.displayText: This is just weird! They were nothing like this when Croque and I were scouting them earlier!

spans.text: This is just weird! They were nothing like this when Croque and I were scouting them earlier!

units.rawText: Logically speaking, there should be a High-Order Entropic serving as their commander. I'll try to intercept their signals!
units.displayText: Logically speaking, there should be a High-Order Entropic serving as their commander. I'll try to intercept their signals!

spans.text: Logically speaking, there should be a High-Order Entropic serving as their commander. I'll try to intercept their signals!

units.rawText: Croque, can you give them another round?
units.displayText: Croque, can you give them another round?

spans.text: Croque, can you give them another round?

units.rawText: Super moves stop being super if you casually spam them!
units.displayText: Super moves stop being super if you casually spam them!

spans.text: Super moves stop being super if you casually spam them!

units.rawText: Also, judging by their rate of advance... Crap, they're going to surround me. Dammit, I can feel my social anxiety kicking in...
units.displayText: Also, judging by their rate of advance... Crap, they're going to surround me. Dammit, I can feel my social anxiety kicking in...

spans.text: Also, judging by their rate of advance... Crap, they're going to surround me. Dammit, I can feel my social anxiety kicking in...

units.rawText: Why the HELL are you getting anxious about the Entropics!?
units.displayText: Why the HELL are you getting anxious about the Entropics!?

spans.text: Why the HELL are you getting anxious about the Entropics!?

units.rawText: Sol, escort the wounded as they fall back. Croque, please cover their withdrawal.
units.displayText: Sol, escort the wounded as they fall back. Croque, please cover their withdrawal.

spans.text: Sol, escort the wounded as they fall back. Croque, please cover their withdrawal.

units.rawText: Sure thing! Recon Team, find us a path! Team Two, with me!
units.displayText: Sure thing! Recon Team, find us a path! Team Two, with me!

spans.text: Sure thing! Recon Team, find us a path! Team Two, with me!

units.rawText: Signal interception... I didn't make any mistakes... But why...
units.displayText: Signal interception... I didn't make any mistakes... But why...

spans.text: Signal interception... I didn't make any mistakes... But why...

units.rawText: Relax. What is it?
units.displayText: Relax. What is it?

spans.text: Relax. What is it?

units.rawText: There's no signal from a High-Order Entropic... I can't find it anywhere!
units.displayText: There's no signal from a High-Order Entropic... I can't find it anywhere!

spans.text: There's no signal from a High-Order Entropic... I can't find it anywhere!

units.rawText: Are these Entropics not under control? Then why did they suddenly know how to attack us?!
units.displayText: Are these Entropics not under control? Then why did they suddenly know how to attack us?!

spans.text: Are these Entropics not under control? Then why did they suddenly know how to attack us?!

units.rawText: I don't understand... Why are they doing this?! Why did it have to be at a time like this?!
units.displayText: I don't understand... Why are they doing this?! Why did it have to be at a time like this?!

spans.text: I don't understand... Why are they doing this?! Why did it have to be at a time like this?!

units.rawText: Before you become a scholar of the ways of the Entropics, can you distract some of them and help us buy time to retreat?
units.displayText: Before you become a scholar of the ways of the Entropics, can you distract some of them and help us buy time to retreat?

spans.text: Before you become a scholar of the ways of the Entropics, can you distract some of them and help us buy time to retreat?

units.rawText: Given their numbers, even being able to draw off some of them would just be a drop in the bucket.
units.displayText: Given their numbers, even being able to draw off some of them would just be a drop in the bucket.

spans.text: Given their numbers, even being able to draw off some of them would just be a drop in the bucket.

units.rawText: That's true...
units.displayText: That's true...

spans.text: That's true...

units.rawText: Oh no, Dirac's going to keel over! Anna, do something!
units.displayText: Oh no, Dirac's going to keel over! Anna, do something!

spans.text: Oh no, Dirac's going to keel over! Anna, do something!

units.rawText: Tsk, you guys pull back first! Don't give them an opening to scatter you!
units.displayText: Tsk, you guys pull back first! Don't give them an opening to scatter you!

spans.text: Tsk, you guys pull back first! Don't give them an opening to scatter you!

units.rawText: Hannah, do we still need to wait?
units.displayText: Hannah, do we still need to wait?

spans.text: Hannah, do we still need to wait?

units.rawText: A voice comes from the communicator in my hand.
units.displayText: A voice comes from the communicator in my hand.

spans.text: A voice comes from the communicator in my hand.

units.rawText: I heard that. Your situation IS very dangerous.
units.displayText: I heard that. Your situation IS very dangerous.

spans.text: I heard that. Your situation IS very dangerous.

units.rawText: Also, you're in this situation because you're coming to save us.
units.displayText: Also, you're in this situation because you're coming to save us.

spans.text: Also, you're in this situation because you're coming to save us.

units.rawText: Don't say that. Rescues are always risky.
units.displayText: Don't say that. Rescues are always risky.

spans.text: Don't say that. Rescues are always risky.

units.rawText: You were right to be cautious. This is a better time than just now.
units.displayText: You were right to be cautious. This is a better time than just now.

spans.text: You were right to be cautious. This is a better time than just now.

units.rawText: (Inhales) Thanks for trying to make me feel better. I'll send people to start up the railgun. In the meantime, please verify the strike coordinates.
units.displayText: (Inhales) Thanks for trying to make me feel better. I'll send people to start up the railgun. In the meantime, please verify the strike coordinates.

spans.text: (Inhales) Thanks for trying to make me feel better. I'll send people to start up the railgun. In the meantime, please verify the strike coordinates.

units.rawText: Oi, oi, wait... Do you even understand the situation here, Hannah? The number of Entropics here is in the four digit range!
units.displayText: Oi, oi, wait... Do you even understand the situation here, Hannah? The number of Entropics here is in the four digit range!

spans.text: Oi, oi, wait... Do you even understand the situation here, Hannah? The number of Entropics here is in the four digit range!

units.rawText: Doesn't that cannon of yours use a ton of operands? How will you stay safe if they're all used up?
units.displayText: Doesn't that cannon of yours use a ton of operands? How will you stay safe if they're all used up?

spans.text: Doesn't that cannon of yours use a ton of operands? How will you stay safe if they're all used up?

units.rawText: If we're trapped in the Admin Center, it doesn't matter how many operands we have.
units.displayText: If we're trapped in the Admin Center, it doesn't matter how many operands we have.

spans.text: If we're trapped in the Admin Center, it doesn't matter how many operands we have.

77.description: A pan-sector-class military self-defense installation. Hannah from the Rossum Sector proposed the project while the Cyclopes and Helios Sector accepted the contract, resulting in a research project born from the cooperation of all three sides.
